title: 'I held my breath': As Kenneth Walker carries Chiefs win, Patrick Mahomes explains where he's fully back — and where he's not

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'I held my breath': As Kenneth Walker carries Chiefs win, Patrick Mahomes explains where he's fully back — and where he's not
sources.description: The Chiefs beat the Broncos by building a team that stepped up around its quarterback. On offense, that started and ended with prized free-agency acquisition Kenneth Walker.
